text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Rice-san, you look rather happy. Did 
something happen?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... You know, when I ran the course 
during class, I got a better time than 
before...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday, I was taught a new running 
style... So this, too, is—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: It's... thanks to you, Big Brother?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Is it... thanks to you, Big Sister?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh... What, how did you know!?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm sorry. When I read late at 
night, sometimes—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I can hear such blissful sleep-talking, 
like, "Thank you, Big Brother..."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I can hear such blissful sleep-talking, 
like, "Thank you, Big Sister..."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
U-Uuu... Uwaaah... This is so 
embarrassinggg...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry... I didn't mean to tease 
you...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"If they're that grateful to you, then you 
must be a truly wonderful Trainer..."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah... Big Brother is the best Trainer 
ever...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah... Big Sister is the best Trainer 
ever...!

Afterward, Rice Shower spent quite some 
time talking about how wonderful her 
Trainer was.
